note: Hours in [2027-05-01, 2029-03-01) UTC at 1-h steps (HEALPix nside 32 screening), interpolated to 1 deg and smoothed with a Gaussian of sigma 3 x 4 pixels (~4 deg). h_tr: point dark, Earth-facing and flash-favourable with >=1 Turkish site available, colour scale clipped between the near-side 5th percentile (lo_hours) and the whole-surface 99.5th percentile (max_hours). h_plume_tr: point dark with possibly sunlit ejecta and >=1 Turkish site, scale 0..99.5th percentile. Geometry only (no orbit, terrain or weather); not a target map.
